name: swarmviz
description: Live multi-agent swarm visualizer — agent graph, attributed diff stream, file tree and LOC delta, inside VS Code

swarmviz.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `swarmviz` binary. Empty resolves `./swarmviz` in the workspace folder, then `swarmviz` on `PATH`.

swarmviz.serverUrl.markdownDescription: Attach to a server that is already running (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8942`) instead of starting one. That server must have been started with `--allow-origin 'vscode-webview://*'`.

swarmviz.port.description: Port for the spawned server. 0 lets the kernel pick a free one, which is what you want when several windows are open.

swarmviz.projectsRoot.markdownDescription: Passed as `--projects-root`: git repositories directly under this directory become switchable in the view alongside the workspace folder.

swarmviz.extraArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments appended to the spawned server.

swarmviz.stopServerOnClose.description: Stop the spawned server when the swarm view is closed. Turning this off keeps the watcher and its shadow copy alive in the background.
